framing: WhyC is a one-input speed weapon: paste a YC job URL, get a deployed Cloud Run preview in ~10 minutes and a self-converged version by morning. The pitch is timestamps, not features.
target_persona: Indie hacker scrolling workatastartup.com at midnight who wants to prove a hosted Next.js preview can ship before the YC company finishes its third hiring round — needs zero setup and a single visible CTA.
opus_4_7_capability: Long-context spec extraction from a job posting plus rapid full-stack codegen — exactly the path that turns a one-line input into a deployable Next.js artifact in under 10 minutes of pipeline time.
mvp_scope: 4-day demo: working URL input → Gemini spec extraction → Next.js scaffold → Cloud Run deploy → first spec-fit score visible. Self-improvement loop wired but limited to 2 iterations for demo timing. | surface: Single-page web landing: one URL input, one 'Ship it' button, prefilled example, 3-step onboarding (paste → watch → wake up converged), live agent log strip. No signup for first preview.
one_liner_pitch: Paste a YC job URL. Get a deployed working preview in 10 minutes. Wake up to 96% spec-fit. While they hire, you ship.
spec_alignment_notes: target_persona=indie hacker / serial founder (spec verbatim) → chose midnight workatastartup.com scroller as concrete instance to keep speed framing native. primary_surface=web hybrid (spec verbatim) → collapsed to single landing + single CTA per persona bias (fastest MVP). killer_feature self-improvement loop honored as 'wake up converged' step rather than removed for speed. mvp_scope respects 24h deploy constraint and 2-person team.
